headline.caveat: estimated: 80% pro-rata share of ~$27B total development cost, funded over the build; ~$7B cash was contributed at close

realized_to_date.caveat: cash contribution at close per Meta's announcement; subsequent pro-rata funding not disclosed

nature_md: Funds managed by Blue Owl Capital own 80% of the Hyperion JV and committed to fund 80% of ~$27B in development costs for Meta's Richland Parish, Louisiana campus. At close, the Blue Owl-managed funds contributed approximately $7B in cash, out of which the JV paid Meta a one-time ~$3B distribution (see related edge). Blue Owl's return is the JV's lease income from Meta, protected by Meta's ~16-year residual-value guarantee. Morgan Stanley arranged the accompanying $27B A+ bond financing.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Held in Blue Owl-managed funds (Real Assets / net-lease strategies) as an equity investment in the JV; fee-earning AUM for Blue Owl the manager. Not on Blue Owl Capital Inc.'s corporate balance sheet.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: JV records equity contributions; combined with the $27B note issuance, this capitalizes the vehicle that owns the campus and leases it to Meta.
